title: Proverbs Chapter 11 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 11 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 11 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 11.

questions.question: What is an abomination to the LORD according to Proverbs 11?
questions.explanation: The verse states that a false balance is an abomination to the LORD, highlighting the importance of fairness in dealings.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:2, what comes with pride?
questions.explanation: The verse explains that pride brings shame, contrasting it with the lowly who possess wisdom.

questions.question: What will guide the integrity of the upright according to Proverbs 11?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:3 states that the integrity of the upright shall guide them.

questions.question: True or False: Riches profit in the day of wrath according to Proverbs 11:4.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:4 states that riches do not profit in the day of wrath, indicating that righteousness is what delivers from death.

questions.question: What shall the righteousness of the perfect direct according to Proverbs 11:5?
questions.explanation: The verse states that the righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way, emphasizing moral guidance.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:6, who shall be taken in their own naughtiness?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:6 indicates that transgressors will be taken in their own naughtiness, highlighting the consequences of wrongdoing.

questions.question: True or False: The righteous is delivered out of trouble according to Proverbs 11:8.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:8 states that the righteous is delivered out of trouble, indicating divine protection for the righteous.

questions.question: What does a hypocrite destroy according to Proverbs 11:9?
questions.explanation: The verse states that a hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor, emphasizing the harm of deceitful speech.

questions.question: What happens when it goes well with the righteous according to Proverbs 11:10?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:10 states that when it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices, showing the positive impact of righteousness on the community.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:12, what does a man of understanding do?
questions.explanation: The verse states that a man of understanding holds his peace, indicating wisdom in communication.

questions.question: True or False: A talebearer reveals secrets according to Proverbs 11:13.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:13 states that a talebearer reveals secrets, contrasting with those who conceal matters with a faithful spirit.

questions.question: In Proverbs 11, which instruction comes before all others listed here?
options: A just weight is his delight
The integrity of the upright shall guide them
He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul
questions.correctAnswer: A just weight is his delight
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:1 is the first instruction in the chapter, emphasizing the importance of honesty in measurements.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 11 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 11 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:12 say about a man of understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:12 states that a man of understanding holds his peace, contrasting with the one who is void of wisdom who despises his neighbor.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:14, what is the benefit of having a multitude of counselors?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:14 indicates that in the multitude of counselors, there is safety, suggesting the wisdom of collective guidance.

questions.question: True or False: A gracious woman retains honor according to Proverbs 11:16.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:16 affirms that a gracious woman retains honor, highlighting the value of grace.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:17 say about the merciful man?
options: He does good to his own soul
questions.correctAnswer: He does good to his own soul
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:17 states that the merciful man does good to his own soul, emphasizing the personal benefits of mercy.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 11:19 connect righteousness and life?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:19 states that righteousness leads to life, while pursuing evil leads to death, reinforcing the value of living righteously.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:20, what does the Lord delight in?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:20 tells us that the upright in their way are a delight to the Lord, contrasting them with those of a froward heart.

questions.question: True or False: He that is surety for a stranger will benefit according to Proverbs 11:15.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:15 warns that he who is surety for a stranger will suffer for it, suggesting that such actions can lead to negative consequences.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:25 say about the liberal soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:25 states that the liberal soul shall be made fat, indicating that generosity leads to abundance.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 11:22 illustrate the lack of discretion?
options: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout
As a wise man among fools
As a strong man without riches
As a merciful man in trouble
questions.correctAnswer: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:22 compares a fair woman without discretion to a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, illustrating how misplaced beauty is worthless.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:10, what happens when the wicked perish?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:10 states that when the wicked perish, there is shouting and rejoicing in the city, indicating a societal response to justice.

questions.question: True or False: The expectation of the wicked is good according to Proverbs 11:23.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:23 asserts that the expectation of the wicked is wrath, contrasting with the desire of the righteous which is only good.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:28 declare about those who trust in their riches?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:28 warns that those who trust in their riches shall fall, emphasizing the risks of relying on wealth rather than righteousness.

questions.question: What is the fate of the wicked according to Proverbs 11:21?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:21 states that the wicked shall not go unpunished, underscoring the certainty of divine justice.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 11 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 11.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:24 suggest about generosity?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:24 states that those who withhold more than is meet tend to poverty, indicating that stinginess brings about a lack rather than abundance.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:25, what happens to a liberal soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:25 states that a liberal soul shall be made fat, suggesting that generosity leads to blessings.

questions.question: What is the fate of those who trust in their riches according to Proverbs 11:28?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:28 clearly states that he that trusteth in his riches shall fall, emphasizing the instability of relying on wealth.

questions.question: In Proverbs 11:30, what is compared to a tree of life?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:30 states that the fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, indicating the vitality and goodness that comes from righteous actions.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:27 say about those who seek good?
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 11:27, he that diligently seeketh good procureth favour, highlighting the positive consequences of seeking goodness.

questions.question: In Proverbs 11:26, what happens to those who withhold corn?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:26 states that he that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him, showing the repercussions of hoarding resources.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 11:20 states that the froward heart is pleasing to the LORD.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:20 indicates that those with a froward heart are an abomination to the LORD, showing that such behavior is unacceptable to Him.

questions.question: True or False: The expectation of the wicked is only good according to Proverbs 11:23.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:23 states that the expectation of the wicked is wrath, contrasting their desires with those of the righteous.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Proverbs 11:23 when contrasting the desires of the righteous and the wicked?
questions.explanation: The verse employs antithesis by contrasting the desires of the righteous with the expectations of the wicked, highlighting their oppositional nature.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage echoes the sentiment that righteousness leads to life, as seen in Proverbs 11:19?
questions.explanation: Romans 6:23 states that the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life, echoing the theme that righteousness leads to life as found in Proverbs 11:19.

questions.question: Which verse emphasizes the importance of counsel and safety, correlating with Proverbs 11:14?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:22 states that without counsel plans fail, which parallels the message of Proverbs 11:14 about the safety found in counsel.

questions.question: In Proverbs 11:21, what will happen to the wicked, regardless of their alliances?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:21 indicates that though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished, affirming that wrongdoing will ultimately be addressed.

questions.question: Which key Hebrew word in Proverbs 11:25 means 'liberal' or 'generous', and what does it signify?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'Nadiv' refers to a willing or generous spirit, which is significant in Proverbs 11:25 as it emphasizes the blessings that come from generosity.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 11 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 11 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:1 teach about fairness in trade?
options: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD
Weights do not matter in trade
questions.correctAnswer: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:1 states that a false balance is an abomination to the LORD, highlighting God's desire for honesty and fairness in trade practices.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:5, what does the righteousness of the perfect direct?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:5 indicates that the righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way, emphasizing the guidance that righteousness provides in life choices.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:18 suggest about those who sow righteousness?
options: They will receive a sure reward
questions.correctAnswer: They will receive a sure reward
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:18 teaches that to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward, indicating the certainty of God's reward for righteous actions.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 11:24 contrast giving and withholding?
options: Scattering results in increase, withholding leads to poverty
questions.correctAnswer: Scattering results in increase, withholding leads to poverty
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:24 states that there is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty, illustrating the paradox of generosity leading to abundance.

questions.question: What attribute of God is revealed in Proverbs 11:20 regarding the upright?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:20 indicates that such as are upright in their way are his delight, revealing God's pleasure in the righteous and upright behavior of His people.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:12 teach about wisdom and relationships?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:12 states that a man of understanding holdeth his peace, emphasizing that wisdom often involves restraint and understanding in relationships.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 11:10 reflect societal response to the righteous?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:10 reveals that when it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth, indicating that the prosperity of the righteous brings joy to the community.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 11:6 and 11:21 convey about the fate of the righteous and wicked?
options: The righteous are delivered; the wicked are punished
questions.correctAnswer: The righteous are delivered; the wicked are punished
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:6 states that the righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, while 11:21 asserts that though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished, emphasizing the justice of God's actions.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:17 teach about the merciful man?
options: He does good to his own soul
questions.correctAnswer: He does good to his own soul
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:17 teaches that the merciful man doeth good to his own soul, indicating that acts of mercy are beneficial not only to others but also to oneself.

questions.question: In Proverbs 11:30, what is the fruit of the righteous compared to?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:30 states that the fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, symbolizing the nourishing and life-giving nature of righteousness.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 11:8, what happens to the wicked?
options: They are delivered out of trouble
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:8 teaches that the wicked cometh in his stead, indicating that the wicked ultimately face trouble and destruction.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:19 convey about the pursuit of evil?
options: It leads to one's own death
questions.correctAnswer: It leads to one's own death
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:19 states that he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death, emphasizing the destructive consequences of pursuing wrongdoing.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 11:26 imply about withholding resources?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:26 indicates that he that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him, highlighting the negative societal consequences of selfishness.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 11:14 emphasize the need for counsel?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:14 teaches that where no counsel is, the people fall, underscoring the importance of guidance and wisdom in decision-making.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that morality is subjective. What does Proverbs 11:3-4 actually teach about integrity and righteousness?
options: Integrity guides the upright; righteousness delivers from death
Morality is based on personal preference
questions.correctAnswer: Integrity guides the upright; righteousness delivers from death
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:3 states that the integrity of the upright shall guide them, while 11:4 teaches that righteousness delivereth from death, affirming objective moral truths rooted in God's character.
